scientific_payload.context_block:
[Document 1]
To determine if temperature during cardiopulmonary bypass (CPB) has an effect on perioperative and postoperative thyroid function.

[Document 2]
Frozen section (FS) evaluation during thyroid surgery is often used to guide intraoperative management. We sought to determine the utility of FS in patients undergoing thyroidectomy for multinodular thyroid disease.

[Document 3]
To evaluate renal damage and impairment of renal function 1 yr after laparoscopic partial nephrectomy (LPN) with warm ischemia>30 min.

[Document 4]
Prospective study comparing thyroid function during and after hypothermic and normothermic CPB.

[Document 5]
Twelve patients scheduled to undergo cardiac operations with normothermic (n = 6) or hypothermic (n = 6) CPB.
